title: うさぎの餅つき
subject_en: Original cute white-cream rabbit characters with pink inner ears, round and soft, doing rice-cake pounding; wooden mortar and mallet. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: うさぎが臼と杵で餅をつく、年末の風景12点。つきたてのお餅、丸める、鏡餅、きなこ餅まで。年末年始のおたよりや年賀状に。
items: a rabbit swinging a wooden mallet over a mortar
a rabbit turning the rice cake with wet hands
a rabbit rolling round rice cakes on a tray
a kagami-mochi two-tier rice cake with an orange on top and a rabbit beside it
a rabbit eating kinako rice cake with a happy face
a plate of anko rice cakes with a rabbit
two rabbits pounding together in rhythm
a rabbit with a steamer full of rice and steam
a baby rabbit holding a small mallet
a rabbit pounding rice cake under a big moon
a rabbit cutting a flat rice cake with a knife
a rabbit with a bowl of ozoni soup
